outline.title: Proctor in GitHub Actions

outline.title: Why add an integrity gate to CI?

outline.title: Permissions are a security decision
outline.summary: Explain contents read, pull-requests write, least privilege, fork PR caution, and secret handling.

outline.title: Capture the agent’s claims explicitly
outline.summary: Explain the Proctor run command, claims-file, PTY capture, and -- separator.

outline.summary: Explain receipt, strict, and comment inputs plus badge and artifact behavior.

outline.summary: Explain the .github/FUNDING.yml configuration, Sponsor button, and how funding supports the roadmap.
